gaps.sentence: He was the first climber ___ the summit without oxygen.
gaps.explanation: After 'the first/last/only + noun' a to-infinitive follows.

gaps.sentence: Despite ___ three times, he didn't give up.
It's not worth ___ about the delay — nothing will change.
She made her son ___ his room before dinner.
gaps.explanation: make + object + bare infinitive: made him tidy (passive takes to: was made to tidy).

gaps.sentence: He was made ___ for the damage to the rental car.
gaps.explanation: In the passive, 'be made to do' takes the to-infinitive.
fail takes the to-infinitive: failed to meet.

gaps.sentence: I've always wanted ___ how to sail.
My boss won't ___ me take Friday off.
gaps.explanation: let + object + bare infinitive: won't let me take. (allow/permit take to: allow me to take.)
